name: LocalSend
author: ansonboby
description: LocalSend from the bar: automatic nearby-device discovery, explicit accept/decline for incoming transfers, share files/folders/clipboard, live transfer progress, and persistent history. Headless controller, no LocalSend GUI or tray.

barWidget.description: Headless LocalSend receiver with device selection, sharing, incoming accept/decline, live transfers, and persistent history.

schema.label: Device alias
schema.description: Name other devices see. Empty = the LocalSend app's own device name, then the hostname.

schema.label: Save incoming files to
schema.description: Where accepted files land. Restarting the receiver (or the shell) applies a change.
